class.name: VehicleRenderingServer
class.brief_description: What a vehicle looks like, drawn.
class.description: Its models, its running gear, its head display, its low-poly interior, the detail it is drawn in and where the player finds it, keyed by the vehicle's [VehicleServer] handle. A kind of vehicle's renderer derives from it - where its server places the vehicle and what its running gear is ([RailVehicleRenderingServer], [RoadVehicleRenderingServer]) - and stands as that kind's singleton; a plugin's renderer derives from a kind's and stands in its place under the same name. It draws through [ModelRenderingServer], whatever backend builds the models.

method.name: builds_get_pending_count
method.description: How many vehicles within the streaming's draw distance still wait for their models to be built. A vehicle's models are built once it stands within the draw distance of the streaming camera, the nearest first, and freed beyond it.

method.name: detection_area_get_vehicle
method.description: The vehicle a detection area ([PhysicsServer3D]) finds - what a shape cast of the player hits; an empty RID for an area that is no vehicle's.

method.name: preloads_drain
method.description: Drops the queued loads of the vehicles' model files and waits for the running ones. The loads run the GDScript model loader on worker threads, so this is called while the scene tree is still alive.

method.name: vehicle_attach
method.description: The vehicle is drawn in the world of the scene node [param node_id], once it has a place: where its kind's server places it, or where [method vehicle_set_transform] says. The node itself is never moved - one that is to follow the vehicle is mounted ([method vehicle_mount_node]). Freed with the vehicle ([signal VehicleServer.vehicle_freed]).

method.name: vehicle_detach
method.description: The vehicle is drawn no more; the models this server built for it are freed.

method.name: vehicle_get_appearance
method.description: What the vehicle looks like, as last set.

method.name: vehicle_get_model
method.description: The exterior model as [ModelRenderingServer] draws it.

method.name: vehicle_get_transform
method.description: Where the vehicle is drawn. The identity for a vehicle not drawn, or without a place yet.

method.name: vehicle_is_attached
method.description: Whether the vehicle is drawn.

method.name: vehicle_is_detailed
method.description: Whether the vehicle is drawn in detail - as nodes, animated - near the camera.

method.name: vehicle_is_editable
method.description: Whether the vehicle's models stand as nodes the editor shows and edits.

method.name: vehicle_mount_node
method.description: A [Node3D] of another layer rides on the vehicle - a cab, a sound emitter, the node of a vehicle assembled by hand: it is put where the vehicle stands - now, when the vehicle has a place - and wherever the vehicle is placed, until [method vehicle_unmount_node] or the vehicle is freed.

method.name: vehicle_set_appearance
method.description: What the vehicle looks like. With model files this server builds the models itself; without, it draws the ones [method vehicle_set_models] hands it.

method.name: vehicle_set_editable
method.description: Whether the vehicle's models stand as nodes the editor shows and edits ("Edit FIZ"): drawn in detail wherever the camera is, under a holder node of the scene, owned by the scene node's owner. Whoever saves the scene takes them off first.

method.name: vehicle_set_head_display_material
method.description: The material the vehicle's head display is drawn with.

method.name: vehicle_set_models
method.description: The exterior and the low-poly interior as [ModelRenderingServer] instances somebody else owns - a vehicle assembled by hand. Announced by [signal vehicle_model_built].

method.name: vehicle_set_scenario
method.description: The world the vehicle's scene node is in, an empty RID out of it: the models this server built for [param vehicle] are drawn there - the node's [constant Node3D.NOTIFICATION_ENTER_WORLD]/[constant Node3D.NOTIFICATION_EXIT_WORLD], as [VisualInstance3D]'s.

method.name: vehicle_set_shown_cabin
method.description: The cabin whose interior is drawn, by whoever shows it, in the place of the low-poly interior's cab it stands for - which a plugin's renderer hides, whoever drives (the player's cab). [code]RID()[/code] while none is: every low-poly cab is drawn.

method.name: vehicle_set_transform
method.description: Where a vehicle its server has not placed is drawn - one assembled by hand, where its node stands. The server's placement takes over once it places the vehicle. A vehicle's models are in no world until it has a place.

method.name: vehicle_unmount_node
method.description: The node rides on the vehicle no more ([method vehicle_mount_node]); it stays where it is.

signal.name: builds_finished
signal.description: No vehicle within the draw distance waits for its models any more: [method builds_get_pending_count] came down to [code]0[/code].

signal.name: vehicle_model_built
signal.description: The vehicle's exterior model was built - as nodes near the camera, as RenderingServer instances far from it; what dresses its nodes does it again.
